_comment: The /flux-stt/ page (flux-stt/index.html): Flux speech-to-text demos. Sections and demos in page order; every id must be in index/demos.json.

sections.heading: Know when they're done talking
sections.intro: Flux decides when a turn ends from what was said, not only from silence. Watch the turn events, start a reply early, cap the wait, or end the turn yourself.

sections.heading: Get the words right
sections.intro: Spell product names and jargon right, teach Flux a new word without reconnecting, and turn spoken numbers into digits.

sections.heading: Run it in production
sections.intro: Close the stream without losing the last words, name raw audio formats, and keep usage records tidy.
